title: Dialogue and question frame sheet
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Reading dialogues: a school event; getting to know each other; the heater
source: Written for arabic/y6 lesson 7 (Dialogue and question frame sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 7: Reading dialogue: getting to know each other. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

arabic.text: أَحْمَدُ: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ، أَنَا أَحْمَدُ، طَالِبٌ جَدِيدٌ. / يُوسُفُ: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ، أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا! مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتَ؟ / أَحْمَدُ: أَنَا مِنْ مِصْرَ. كَمْ عُمْرُكَ؟ / يُوسُفُ: عُمْرِي إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً. مَا هِوَايَتُكَ؟ / أَحْمَدُ: هِوَايَتِي القِرَاءَةُ. / يُوسُفُ: تَشَرَّفْنَا!
arabic.ref: Our own dialogue for 'getting to know each other' (Kitabi version: CHECK IN KITABI)

panels.title: Saying my age
points: عُمْرِي عَشْرُ سَنَوَاتٍ: I am ten
عُمْرِي إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً: I am eleven

parts.text: Find Ahmad's line with مِنْ: أَنَا مِنْ مِصْرَ. Change أَنَا to his name. Answer: Ahmadu min Misr.

questions.a: أَحْمَدُ مِنْ مِصْرَ (Ahmad is from Egypt)

questions.q: Core: Answer the three key questions about yourself in Arabic (portal response box).
questions.a: For example: أَنَا مِنْ بِرِيطَانِيَا. عُمْرِي عَشْرُ سَنَوَاتٍ. هِوَايَتِي القِرَاءَةُ.

questions.q: Extend: In a breakout pair, act out a getting-to-know-you dialogue using your own answers.
questions.a: Six-line dialogue with greeting, three questions and تَشَرَّفْنَا

questions.q: Stretch: Write the dialogue out with a new pupil who is a girl, changing the endings.
questions.a: For example: مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتِ؟ كَمْ عُمْرُكِ؟ مَا هِوَايَتُكِ؟
B) القِرَاءَة (reading). Ahmad says هِوَايَتِي القِرَاءَةُ: my hobby is reading.

questions.q: كَمْ عُمْرُكَ؟ asks: A) your age B) your name C) your hobby
Big question: which questions help us get to know someone new? Write two in Arabic.
questions.a: For example: مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتَ؟ مَا هِوَايَتُكَ؟
